# Graeme Butcher

Graeme Butcher is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 2006.

Graeme Butcher has participated in 2 elections since 2002:

- [**2006 St John Connétable Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/graeme-butcher#e37)

  Elected as Connétable of St John unopposed.
- [**2008 Connétables Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/graeme-butcher#e11)

  Elected as Connétable of St John unopposed.

* * *

* * *

## Election History

### 2006 St John Connétable Election

Election for the role of Connétable of [St John](https://flow.je/elections/st-john) (1 seat), 7th November 2006.

**Graeme Butcher was elected as Connétable of St John in 2006 unopposed**.

### 2008 Connétables Election

Election for the role of Connétable of [St John](https://flow.je/elections/st-john) (1 seat), 15th October 2008.

**Graeme Butcher was elected as Connétable of St John in 2008 unopposed**.
